# Ojeda Works

> Ojeda Works is the parent brand over AO Audit, video production, website development, content and social, and advertising — run by one person, Alejandro Ojeda, in Napa, CA. The premise across every division: make a business the answer AI and Google give, not just one option in a list.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://ojedaworks.com/): what Ojeda Works is and the four divisions
- [Video](https://ojedaworks.com/video.html): explainers, short-form ads, and social video built around one true point
- [Website Development](https://ojedaworks.com/web-development.html): fast static sites with schema markup AI models can read
- [Content & Social](https://ojedaworks.com/content-social.html): copy and social content in English and Spanish, written to answer real customer questions
- [Advertising](https://ojedaworks.com/advertising.html): campaigns built around one real offer with tracked results
- [About](https://ojedaworks.com/about.html): why Ojeda Works exists and how it started with AO Audit
- [Contact](https://ojedaworks.com/contact.html): how to reach Alejandro directly
- [Español](https://ojedaworks.com/es.html): the Spanish-language landing page

## Related

- [AO Audit](https://aoaudit.com/): the flagship product — checks whether AI models actually recommend a business and fixes what's stopping them

## Facts

- One person does the work across all divisions; no account managers or handoffs.
- No fabricated reviews, statistics, or credentials — every claim on the site is checkable.
- Based in Napa, CA; serves small businesses in Napa County and beyond, in English and Spanish.
